description: This file defines an abstract service class for fetching match data and a mock implementation for testing within a dating app frontend project.

classes.name: MatchService
classes.description: An abstract interface defining a method to fetch match information based on query parameters.

classes.name: MockMatchService
classes.description: A mock implementation of MatchService that returns predefined match items for testing purposes.

methods.description: Fetches a list of MatchItem objects based on the provided query map.
